import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem unique_commutation_exponent {G : Type*} [Group G]
  (hG : ∀ (H : Subgroup G), H.Normal)
  (a : G)
  (hinf : ∀ n : ℤ, a ^ n = 1 → n = 0)
  (b : G) :
  ∃! j : ℤ, b * a = a ^ j * b := by
  have hN : (Subgroup.zpowers a).Normal := hG (Subgroup.zpowers a)
  have ha_mem : a ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a := by
    rw [Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff]
    exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
  have hconj : b * a * b⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a := by
    first
    | exact hN.conj_mem (n := a) ha_mem b
    | exact hN.conj_mem ha_mem b
    | haveI : (Subgroup.zpowers a).Normal := hN
      exact Subgroup.Normal.conj_mem ha_mem b
  rw [Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff] at hconj
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hconj
  have hj_eq : b * a * b⁻¹ = a ^ j := by
    first | exact hj | exact hj.symm
  have hb : b * a = a ^ j * b := by
    calc b * a = (b * a * b⁻¹) * b := by group
      _ = a ^ j * b := by rw [hj_eq]
  refine ⟨j, hb, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hk' : a ^ k * b = a ^ j * b := by
    calc a ^ k * b = b * a := hk.symm
      _ = a ^ j * b := hb
  have heq : a ^ k = a ^ j := mul_right_cancel hk'
  have hsub : a ^ (k - j) = 1 := by
    calc a ^ (k - j) = a ^ k * (a ^ j)⁻¹ := by
          rw [sub_eq_add_neg, zpow_add, zpow_neg]
      _ = 1 := by rw [heq, mul_inv_cancel]
  have hzero : k - j = 0 := hinf _ hsub
  omega

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem unique_commutation_exponent {G : Type*} [Group G]
  (hG : ∀ (H : Subgroup G), H.Normal)
  (a : G)
  (hinf : ∀ n : ℤ, a ^ n = 1 → n = 0)
  (b : G) :
  ∃! j : ℤ, b * a = a ^ j * b := by
  let H : Subgroup G := Subgroup.closure ({a} : Set G)
  
  have ha : a ∈ H := by
    exact (Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton).2 ⟨1, by simp⟩
  
  have hconj : b * a * b⁻¹ ∈ H := by
    exact (hG H).conj_mem a ha b
  
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton).1 hconj
  
  have hcomm : b * a = a ^ j * b := by
    calc
      b * a = (b * a * b⁻¹) * b := by group
      _ = a ^ j * b := by rw [hj]
  
  refine ⟨j, hcomm, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  
  have hpow : a ^ j = a ^ k := by
    apply mul_right_cancel
    calc
      a ^ j * b = b * a := hcomm.symm
      _ = a ^ k * b := hk
  
  have hzero : a ^ (j - k) = 1 := by
    rw [zpow_sub, hpow]
    simp
  
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (hinf (j - k) hzero)).symm
